rv.q: Anyone with a theatrical bone in their body will be thrilled by experiencing this genuinely great actor at the height of his powers.
“All the Devils Are Here” is a truly remarkable experience that is as multifaceted and expertly connived as the villains it portrays.

cn.t: Patrick Page delivers a spectacular performance dissecting Shakespeare's villains, with critics praising the actor at the height of his powers in this thrilling exploration of wickedness and villainy.
